payload.title: papyrus site google-secrets: standard command replacing per-site Google OAuth secrets scripts
payload.description: Add `papyrus site google-secrets set` and `check`, run from a site repo. Reads infra/site.json for stack, app and Cognito domain prefix; asserts the AWS account with STS before any write; prompts for the client id and a hidden secret (or --client-id and stdin); writes the Amplify secret SSM SecureStrings at /amplify/<appId>/<branch>-branch-<hash>/GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET; prints the Google Cloud Console origin and redirect URI to register and the redeploy step. check reports names, last-modified, fingerprints and whether the deployed Cognito Google IdP uses the same client id. Never enables or disables Google OAuth (mentions PAPYRUS_DISABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH). Tests with fake SSM/STS. Docs: site-hosting.md and the CLI reference. After release, the two ~/Projects *-store-google-secrets.sh scripts become a one-line pointer.
